Subject: Redwood credits for LaunchLane pilot (SI-backed)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — the LaunchLane team is excited to kick off a 6-week pilot with one of our strategic customers. Their SI (EdgeScale) will lead implementation. Before we spin up environments, we wanted to confirm whether Redwood can provide partner-sourced marketplace credits to cover initial usage (expected ~150k tokens/week) and a 30-day trial extension for accelerated evaluation.

What would help us:
- Confirmation of eligible promo/marketplace credits (amount and expiry)
- Any required statement of use / intake form we should complete
- Typical lead time for provisioning credits on a marketplace listing

We'd like to align on a mutual action plan this week so EdgeScale can schedule the kickoff. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Clara Ng
Partnerships Lead — Accelerate.co
LaunchLane program contact

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for LaunchLane pilot (SI-backed)

Clara —

Really excited to see this progress. Short answers first: yes, we can typically route partner-sponsored marketplace credits for SI-backed pilots; and we can do a 30-day trial extension in the console for this use case. A couple of operational notes:

- We usually provision credits as a Marketplace "promo voucher" tied to the LaunchLane account and the EdgeScale SI partner.
- We'll need a simple statement of intended use (one page) and the SI's MoP (scope of work) to justify scope and expected consumption.
- Provisioning lead time is ~2 business days once paperwork is in place; if we need a faster ramp we can approve a temporary token-limited allocation while docs finish.

I've looped in Soojin for budget/approval and Jordan for delivery coordination.

Next steps I propose:
1) Clara/LaunchLane share the one-page statement and EdgeScale MoP (attach to reply).
2) Soojin to confirm promo bucket availability and any program-level discounts.
3) Jordan to produce a short onboarding runbook + token estimate and flag any infra constraints.

If useful, Jordan and I can join a call tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partner GTM — Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Redwood credits for LaunchLane pilot (SI-backed)

Thanks Sofia / Clara — quick operational reply.

- Promo bucket: We have a partner-sponsored marketplace pool for Q4; I can allocate up to $5k USD equivalent in credits for qualified pilots from that pool. If LaunchLane expects >$5k run rate over the pilot, we'll need a short approval from Channel Finance (I can expedite).
- Paperwork: please send the statement_of_use + SI MoP. Legal asks that the statement include: pilot objective, pilot duration, expected monthly token volume, and confirmation that customer data will not be exported outside their VPC (if private).
- Expiry: promotional vouchers issued via marketplace are typically 90 days from grant. Trial extension in-console will add 30 days but doesn't change voucher expiry.

Attachment: I reviewed the sample MoP that EdgeScale provided during onboarding; added a checklist in the attached spreadsheet (si_onboarding_mop.xlsx) — Jordan, please complete the onboarding runbook sections and return.

Soojin Lee
Partner Programs — Redwood Inference

- Timeline: paperwork (attached) returned today -> voucher provisioned within 2 business days -> kickoff Tue Nov 2 (EdgeScale availability permitting).
